title: HUD values: non-0 · p · 1 · all · inf. compare ALL to null-D. budget-sort what may leave.

do_not_reinvent.zero: /data/zero-most-common.json  0 is the common state. not a displayed rank.
do_not_reinvent.budget: /data/api-willis-inverse.json + js/pi-budget.js  never fill p. remainder empty.
do_not_reinvent.waste: /data/waste-category.json  excrete is a kind. not one incinerator.

values.0: not shown. pale. equals null-D. most common.
values.non-0: something moved. not yet a rank. the first heat.
values.p: the leak. remainder. hinge. L_p. compare as hole, not as mass.
values.1: incarnate. earned flip. a door may pass this.
values.all: totality. do not exfil as a dump. look, do not ship the ocean.
values.inf: over budget. frozen. glass. does not leave.

compare_to_null_d.yes: every grain vs the empty point.
compare_to_null_d.non-0_to_1: distance from the point. how much it filled.
compare_to_null_d.p: the remainder hole beside the point.
compare_to_null_d.all: the disc. not a point. cannot equal null-D.
compare_to_null_d.inf: off the disc. do not compare  hold.

budget_sort_exfil.yes: this scale sorts what may LEAVE (excrete / outer face). not a spy exfil.
budget_sort_exfil.leave: p leak a little. 1 may pass a p-door.
budget_sort_exfil.stay: 0 stays pale. all stays a look. inf stays ice.
budget_sort_exfil.refuse: do not ship all. do not punch inf through a window.

pull: display non-0 p 1 all inf. keep 0 unseen. compare to null-D. only p and 1 may leave, and only through a door.
